abstract: OBJECTIVE: The standard treatment for young patients with stage I malignant ovarian germ cell tumors, except stage I dysgerminoma and stage IA G1 immature teratoma, is unilateral salpingo-oophorectomy with complete staging surgery followed by platinum-based chemotherapy. However, the role of complete staging surgery and adjuvant chemotherapy remains controversial. The aim of this study was to investigate the role of complete staging surgery and adjuvant chemotherapy in patients with early-stage pure immature teratoma after fertility-sparing surgery. METHODS: Patients with stage I pure immature teratoma who underwent fertility-sparing surgery between January 1986 and June 2018 were reviewed retrospectively. Fertility-sparing surgery was defined as preservation of the uterus and at least one adnexa. The inclusion criteria were age >18 years, stage I disease (confined to one ovary), and diagnosis of pure immature teratoma. Patients with distant metastasis or mixed ovarian germ cell tumor were excluded. Complete staging surgery was defined as peritoneal cytology examination, peritoneal biopsy, omentectomy, or omental biopsy with or without lymph node dissection. Patients designated with stage I disease without complete staging surgery were categorized as stage X. Disease-free survival was defined as the interval from the date of surgery to the date of recurrence or censoring. Disease-free survival curves were calculated using the Kaplan-Meier method and compared using the log-rank test. RESULTS: A total of 75 patients were included in the analysis, with a median age of 26 years (range 18-40): 26 (34.7%) patients had received complete staging surgery; 51 (68%) patients received postoperative adjuvant chemotherapy while 24 (32%) underwent surgery alone; and 4 patients (5.3%) had recurrent disease during a median follow-up time of 80.2 months (range 13.7-261). The recurrence rates in the chemotherapy group and surveillance groups were 3.9% and 8.3%, respectively (p=0.46). All patients were successfully salvaged, except for one death. Tumor relapse occurred in patients with all grades of immature teratoma (G1: 1/35; G2: 2/25; G3: 1/15). Univariate analysis revealed that complete staging surgery, adjuvant chemotherapy, and tumor grade were not associated with 5 year disease-free survival (p=0.69, p=0.46, p=0.7, respectively). The 5 year disease-free survival rate was 94.6% and the overall survival rate was 98.7%. CONCLUSION: Adult patients with stage I pure immature teratoma had 98.7% overall survival and recurrence rates were low after fertility-sparing surgery.
abstract_ja: 目的：ディスジャーミノーマおよびIA期G1の未熟奇形腫を除く、若年患者の病期I期の悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍に対する標準治療は、完全な病期分類手術を伴う片側卵管卵巣摘出術の後に白金系化学療法を行うことである。しかし、完全な病期分類手術と補助化学療法の役割については、依然として議論が続いている。本研究の目的は、妊孕性温存手術を受けた早期の純粋未熟奇形腫患者において、完全な病期分類手術と補助化学療法の役割を検討することであった。方法：1986年1月から2018年6月の間に妊孕性温存手術を受けた病期I期の純粋未熟奇形腫患者を後方視的に検討した。妊孕性温存手術は、子宮と少なくとも一方の付属器の温存と定義した。選択基準は、年齢18歳超、病期I期（片側卵巣に限局）、純粋未熟奇形腫の診断であった。遠隔転移または混合型卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者は除外した。完全な病期分類手術は、腹膜細胞診、腹膜生検、大網切除または大網生検を、リンパ節郭清の有無にかかわらず行うものと定義した。完全な病期分類手術を行わず病期I期と判定された患者は、病期Xに分類した。無病生存期間は、手術日から再発または打ち切りまでの期間と定義した。無病生存曲線はKaplan-Meier法により算出し、log-rank検定により比較した。結果：解析に含まれたのは計75例で、年齢中央値は26歳（範囲18～40歳）であった。26例（34.7%）が完全な病期分類手術を受けた。51例（68%）が術後補助化学療法を受け、24例（32%）が手術単独であった。4例（5.3%）が再発を認めた。フォローアップ期間中央値は80.2か月（範囲13.7～261か月）であった。化学療法群と経過観察群の再発率は、それぞれ3.9%と8.3%であった（p=0.46）。死亡1例を除き、全例が救援治療に成功した。腫瘍再発は、全グレードの未熟奇形腫に認められた（G1：1/35、G2：2/25、G3：1/15）。単変量解析では、完全な病期分類手術、補助化学療法、腫瘍グレードは5年無病生存期間と関連しなかった（それぞれp=0.69、p=0.46、p=0.7）。5年無病生存率は94.6%、全生存率は98.7%であった。結論：病期I期の純粋未熟奇形腫の成人患者は全生存率98.7%であり、妊孕性温存手術後の再発率は低かった。
